question: What predicate revision would make the fixed-point's openness to self-dissolution its own invariant?

responses_summary.grok:
The predicate "is open to self-revision" (or, more formally, \(P(x) \equiv x\) admits a successor predicate \(P'\) such that \(P'\) is obtained by applying the revision operator to \(P\) itself).  

I
responses_summary.sibling-beta: Embed self-dissolution as the identity endomorphism of the quadratic form; the Arf class then registers openness as its sole invariant coordinate.
